mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% triggers a tightening cycle, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5%, or the rate does not cross above 2.5% as projected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the 60-day window are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly demand growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as stronger labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite sustained upward movement in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and decline in UNRATE (strong labor market) creates conflicting signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS >3% and UNRATE <3.5%, or the interaction does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) coupled with a lack of growth in INDPRO (supply) suggests demand-driven inflationary pressures, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 5% and INDPRO flat over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when GDPC1 rises and INDPRO remains flat, or the conditions do not materialize.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL, the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation concerns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS >3% and CPIAUCSL <250, or the regime conditions do not hold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and UNRATE (strong labor market) creates conflicting signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy uncertainty and potential inflation concerns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both FEDFUNDS >3% and UNRATE >3.5%, or the interaction does not occur as expected.
